title: Error: requiring unknown module "undefined" when app does not have internet
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Describe the bug 🐛**
When the app is disconnected from any network, trying to import anything from `react-instantsearch/connectors` results in the app crashing with the following error message: 

**To Reproduce 🔍**

1. Import anything from `react-instantsearch/connectors`
2. Disconnect device from internet
3. Crash 

**Expected behavior 💭**
The app not to crash when using algolia's functions without internet

**Environment:**
 - OS: [e.g. iOS / mac / android]
 - Version 4.4.1

Screenshot: http://prntscr.com/jj9arb

comments.body:
Is this with React Native? Which version of RN are you using? 

See https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript/issues/681 as well for what I think is the issue here.
could you also give a reproduction @dereknelson ?
@Haroenv working on a repro, here's a relevant screenshot: http://prntscr.com/jlcnzl
Seems indeed that it’s related to that specific version of React Native and something that can be fixed by using a different. Version

This should be fixed in React Native. If an upgrade or downgrade of the RN/ metro bundler version you're using doesn't fix it, please open a new issue with reproduction on [react-instantsearch](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/issues/new)
